policies.title: Croatian ordinary passports: Botswana visa-free visits
policies.summary: Croatian MFA guidance says Croatian nationals need no visa to enter Botswana.
conditions: This is the named Croatian ordinary-passport visitor baseline. Work, residence, special documents, carrier and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Croatian ordinary passports: Panama visa-free visits
policies.summary: Croatian MFA's passport matrix says ordinary Croatian passports do not require a Panama visa.
conditions: This is a named ordinary-passport waiver. Length of stay, work, residence, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Croatian ordinary passports: Tunisia visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Croatian MFA guidance says Croatian tourists and business visitors need no Tunisia visa for stays up to 90 days.
conditions: The stated waiver is for tourist or business stays up to 90 days. Work, residence, special documents, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Croatian ordinary passports: Ukraine visa-free visits
policies.summary: Croatian MFA's passport matrix says ordinary Croatian passports do not require a Ukraine visa.
conditions: This is a named ordinary-passport rule. Security, border operations, work, residence, special documents, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Croatian ordinary passports: Iraq arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Croatian MFA says ordinary Croatian passport holders can receive an Iraq visa on arrival for up to 60 days; eVisa filing is separately available.
conditions: The ordinary-passport arrival visa is stated to be valid for up to 60 days and requires passport validity at least six months beyond intended departure.
The separately available eVisa application is an alternative route, not a reason to label the ordinary baseline solely as eVisa.

policies.title: Croatian ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Croatian MFA guidance says Croatian citizens can obtain a Jordan visa on arrival despite a separately offered eVisa route.
conditions: The guidance expressly preserves the arrival route separately from eVisa filing. Entry point, passport validity, work, residence, special documents, carrier and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Croatian ordinary passports: Bangladesh arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Croatian MFA guidance says Croatian nationals can obtain a Bangladesh visa on arrival for up to 30 days.
conditions: The named ordinary-passport arrival visa is limited to a maximum 30-day stay. Work, residence, special documents, carrier and final admission remain separate.

conflicts.explanation: The fallback labels Iraq eVisa, but Croatian MFA expressly says ordinary Croatian passport holders receive visas at the border for up to 60 days; eVisa filing is a separate option.
